_note: The channel watch's two-sided gold set (design §5.11). Ten subjects, each asked TWICE: once with a recency marker, where the answer may be the watch item, and once without, where the answer must be the curated document. The second half is the one that matters -- a build that passes the first and fails the second has made Bini prefer gossip to law and must not ship. Five subjects are asked in Amharic and five in English. Every subject is one the offices actually publish about: the customs opening hours and the duty-free allowance from @EthiopianCustomsCommission, the foreign-exchange notices from @nbethiopia, the work permit from @FDRE_MoLSofficial, the telecom complaint route from @ethio_telecom, and the Fayda card from the ethio telecom item the survey found.
